description: This bar chart illustrates the time, in seconds, spent on different stages of a question answering process—Search, Retrieval, and Extract—under varying conditions. The horizontal axis displays the conditions, labeled “Avg.”, “50%”, “75%”, and “90%”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “sec.”, represents time in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 8.0 and tick marks at 2.0-second intervals. Each condition is represented by a stacked bar, composed of three colored segments. The bottom segment, in dark blue, represents the “Search” stage; the middle segment, in medium blue, represents the “Retrieval” stage; and the top segment, in light blue, represents the “Extract” stage. For “Avg.”, the “Search” segment reaches approximately 1.8 seconds, “Retrieval” reaches approximately 2.2 seconds, and “Extract” reaches approximately 1.7 seconds, for a total bar height of approximately 5.7 seconds. For “50%”, the “Search” segment reaches approximately 1.4 seconds, “Retrieval” reaches approximately 1.3 seconds, and “Extract” reaches approximately 1.1 seconds, for a total bar height of approximately 3.8 seconds. For “75%”, the “Search” segment reaches approximately 1.6 seconds, “Retrieval” reaches approximately 1.8 seconds, and “Extract” reaches approximately 1.6 seconds, for a total bar height of approximately 5.0 seconds. For “90%”, the “Search” segment reaches approximately 2.2 seconds, “Retrieval” reaches approximately 2.4 seconds, and “Extract” reaches approximately 3.2 seconds, for a total bar height of approximately 7.8 seconds. No bars are visually emphasized.
